title: Top 5 WINDIEST Planets In The Universe
hook: Number one has winds that break the speed of sound.

items.name: Mars
items.stat: Dust storms whip winds up to 60 mph and can engulf the entire planet for weeks.

items.name: Jupiter
items.stat: Jet streams roar at 400 mph, driving the centuries-old Great Red Spot storm.

items.name: Uranus
items.stat: Winds reach 560 mph on a planet tipped completely on its side.

items.name: Saturn
items.stat: Equatorial winds blast at 1,100 mph, among the fastest in the solar system.

items.name: Neptune
items.stat: Supersonic winds scream up to 1,300 mph, the fastest known on any planet.
